description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's Oracle data access and photo storage to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including database-specific schema and query changes.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace Oracle-specific SQL and data types with PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including converting photo BLOB storage to bytea. Update datasource configuration to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL and use Managed Identity authentication instead of plaintext credentials.
